contexts: nurse-led clinic already running in two practices
discounted therapeutic diet for both groups
owners pay for visits in usual care
reading: The clinic works through owners: it changes what they feed, how they exercise the dog and whether they come back. Mobility is the outcome owners value, but owners also know which group they are in and report improvement from expectation alone (claim c3), so a blinded lameness assessment and weight are needed alongside. Retention is the weak link of weight clinics (claim c4), and hunger behaviours are the welfare cost to watch. Practice-level differences in nurse enthusiasm call for stratified central allocation (claim c5).

nodes.label: Nurse-led weight clinic
nodes.detail: Monthly weigh-ins, food allowance, exercise plan, phone check-in.

nodes.label: Caregiver expectation

nodes.detail: Deliver the diet and report the outcome.

summary: Map connects the clinic and usual advice to owner-reported mobility through owners, with expectation bias and attrition marked.
